card.name: Word starts before metal or copper words
card.fires_on: Short word starts or joiners such as a comma, a capital C, '-m' or ' St' that sit just before a word is completed. Often in medical text and gear lists, where the next piece could begin a metal-related word like iron, copper or can.

modes.label: Hyphen and letter joiners
modes.description: A short piece such as '-m' or '-C' that begins the next part of a compound or drug term.
modes.example: The estimated overdose of orally ingested iron is 300<<-m>>g/kg body weight.

modes.label: Capital C starting a term
modes.description: A lone C or c that begins a term like CYP3A or canning or canteen.
modes.example: Other Drugs Hormonal Contraceptives (<<C>>YP3A Substrates) Prevention

modes.label: Punctuation or URL piece
modes.description: A comma or URL letter fragment before the rest of a list or web path.
modes.example: Do not use for reproduction, copying<<,>> pasting, or reading; exclusively for

card.writes: It pushes the model toward metal words like metal, copper and iron, and away from code-like tokens.
card.plain: It fires on small word beginnings, often C or a hyphen piece, and nudges the model toward metal words such as iron or copper.
